summary: Clean. Secret hygiene: commit 4289c9a contains NO Telegram bot token or any other leaked secret. The application.properties diff only changes the app.url loca.lt subdomain (purple-beans-type -> fair-guests-exist, a public dev-tunnel host, not a credential); file history and the full tracked tree were scanned for the Telegram token shape ([0-9]{8,10}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}) and none exist in application.properties or .env.example. .env.example: all secret-bearing vars (BOT_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY, SUBSCRIBER_EXPORT_TOKEN_KEY, MAIL_PASSWORD) are empty; SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD is a placeholder; the three new funnel vars (FUNNEL_SCHEDULER_INTERVAL=PT30S, FUNNEL_MAX_STEPS=50, FUNNEL_SWEEP_BATCH_SIZE=200) are non-sensitive tuning knobs; 'NEVER commit a real value' guidance present. Cascade (A01/GDPR erase-on-delete): ProjectHardDeleteJob deletes funnels + funnel_executions via removeByProjectId using Criteria.where('projectId').in(deletedIds) where deletedIds is strictly the soft-deleted+aged set from findByDeletedAtBefore(cutoff) (deletedAt < cutoff excludes never-deleted null-deletedAt projects) — no over-broad cross-tenant deletion, no under-deletion leaving orphaned PII (sweep runs before the projects drop, idempotent on partial-crash re-run). Cross-project isolation proven by cron_cascadeDoesNotTouchFunnelsOfOtherProjects (active control project's rows survive). Logging (Decision 16): new counters funnelsRemoved/funnelExecutionsRemoved are pure counts; logEvent metadata is projectId+project name only — no payload/PII/message bodies. Runbook docs/staging-smoke/10-funnels.md explicitly warns never to paste bot token, mongosh connection string, or real numeric chat ids into chat/commits/screenshots, mandates reading mongo creds from the staging secret store, uses placeholders, and reiterates Decision-16 no-payload-in-logs. local-setup.md promotes gitleaks pre-commit scanning. No OWASP Top 10 issues introduced by this task.
